declarations.description: Rozie's cross-framework port of wavesurfer.js v7 — a data-bound audio waveform player with two two-way bindings (`currentTime`, `regions`), live plugin presence (Timeline/Hover/Regions), and an imperative handle.
declarations.name: Waveform

members.name: src
members.description: The audio URL the waveform loads. Bound at construction and reconciled at runtime — changing it calls the engine `load(url)`.

members.name: peaks
members.description: Pre-computed waveform peaks (an array of channel sample arrays, or a single `number[]`). Renders the waveform without downloading or decoding audio — pair with `duration`. Construction-only.

members.name: duration
members.description: The audio duration in seconds. Required alongside `peaks` when rendering without a decodable `src` (the timeline/ruler and region positions are derived from it). Construction-only.

members.name: height
members.description: The waveform height in pixels. Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: waveColor
members.description: The color of the unplayed portion of the waveform. Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: progressColor
members.description: The color of the played (progress) portion of the waveform. Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: cursorColor
members.description: The color of the playback cursor. Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: cursorWidth
members.description: The width of the playback cursor in pixels. Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: barWidth
members.description: Draw the waveform as bars of this pixel width. `null` (default) renders a continuous waveform. Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: barGap
members.description: The pixel gap between bars (when `barWidth` is set). Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: barRadius
members.description: The corner radius of bars (when `barWidth` is set). Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: minPxPerSec
members.description: The minimum pixels-per-second zoom level. Reconciled at runtime via `zoom`.

members.name: volume
members.description: Playback volume (`0`–`1`). Reconciled at runtime via `setVolume`.

members.name: playbackRate
members.description: Playback speed multiplier. Reconciled at runtime via `setPlaybackRate`.

members.name: autoplay
members.description: Begin playback as soon as the audio is ready. Construction-only.

members.name: normalizeAmplitude
members.description: Normalize the waveform by its largest peak (wavesurfer's `normalize` option). Reconciled at runtime via `setOptions`.

members.name: hideScrollbar
members.description: Hide the horizontal scrollbar when the waveform is zoomed wider than its container. Construction-only.

members.name: disableInteraction
members.description: Disable click/seek interaction with the waveform (the engine defaults to interactive). Construction-only.

members.name: disableDragToSeek
members.description: Disable drag-to-seek across the waveform (the engine defaults to drag-seekable). Construction-only.

members.name: timeline
members.description: Render a time-ruler beneath the waveform (the wavesurfer Timeline plugin). Live-toggleable — registers/unregisters on the running engine, no remount.

members.name: hover
members.description: Show a hover cursor with a time label as the pointer moves over the waveform (the wavesurfer Hover plugin). Live-toggleable — registers/unregisters on the running engine, no remount.

members.name: hoverColor
members.description: The line color of the Hover plugin cursor (only applies when `hover` is enabled). Read/applied when the Hover plugin is (re-)created — not live on an already-registered instance.

members.name: regions
members.description: The interactive regions as an array of `{ id?, start, end?, content?, color?, drag?, resize? }`. Providing an array (even empty) registers the Regions plugin — at construction if it's already an array, or lazily the first time `regions` transitions from `null`/`undefined` to an array. Two-way (`model: true`): user create / drag / resize / remove writes the updated array back (round-trip-guarded); a consumer write reconciles the live regions (add / update / remove by `id`).

members.name: dragToCreateRegions
members.description: Allow drawing new regions by dragging over empty waveform space (Regions plugin `enableDragSelection`). Requires `regions` to be an array. Read/applied when the Regions plugin is (re-)created — not live on an already-registered instance.

members.name: regionColor
members.description: Default fill color for drag-created regions (only applies when `dragToCreateRegions` is on). Read/applied when the Regions plugin is (re-)created — not live on an already-registered instance.

members.name: options
members.description: Raw wavesurfer `WaveSurferOptions` passthrough — spread into `WaveSurfer.create()` before the curated keys (explicit props win). Use it for any v7 option not surfaced as a first-class prop (`sampleRate`, `mediaControls`, `splitChannels`, `barHeight`, …).

members.name: currentTime
members.description: The current playback position in seconds. The lone two-way `model: true` prop: playback writes the live position back on every `timeupdate` (round-trip-guarded so a programmatic write does not ping-pong), and a consumer write seeks the engine via `setTime`.

members.name: play
members.description: Start playback.

members.name: pause
members.description: Pause playback.

members.name: playPause
members.description: Toggle between play and pause.

members.name: stop
members.description: Stop playback and return the cursor to the start.

members.name: seekTo
members.description: Seek to a relative position — `seekTo(progress)` where `progress` is `0`–`1`.

members.name: setTime
members.description: Seek to an absolute position in seconds — `setTime(seconds)`.

members.name: setVolume
members.description: Set the playback volume — `setVolume(v)` where `v` is `0`–`1`.

members.name: setPlaybackRate
members.description: Set the playback speed multiplier — `setPlaybackRate(rate)`.

members.name: setZoom
members.description: Set the zoom level in pixels-per-second — `setZoom(pxPerSec)`.

members.name: load
members.description: Load a new audio source URL — `load(url)`.

members.name: isPlaying
members.description: Return whether audio is currently playing (`boolean`).

members.name: getDuration
members.description: Return the total duration in seconds (`0` before the audio is ready).

members.name: getCurrentTime
members.description: Return the current playback position in seconds.

members.name: getWaveSurfer
members.description: Return the underlying wavesurfer instance for direct API access (the engine escape hatch). Null before mount.

members.name: addRegion
members.description: Add a region imperatively — `addRegion({ start, end?, id?, content?, color?, drag?, resize? })`. Returns the created engine Region. Requires the `regions` array to have registered the plugin. Null when regions are disabled.

members.name: clearRegions
members.description: Remove all regions.

members.name: getRegions
members.description: Return the live engine Region objects (empty array when regions are disabled).
